The Homeless Boy Who Invented Louis Vuitton tells the inspiring story of Louis Vuitton, who rose from humble beginnings as a poor, homeless child in France to become the founder of one of the world’s most iconic luxury brands. At the age of 13, he left his home and walked to Paris, where he learned the craft of trunk-making. His innovative designs and expert craftsmanship soon caught the attention of the elite, and he went on to create a brand synonymous with luxury, elegance, and travel. His story is a testament to resilience, ingenuity, and the power of dreams.
